query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ar.documentoVinculadoNumero, ar.parcela, so.estadoConfiguravel FROM accounts_receivable ar LEFT JOIN sales_orders so ON CAST(ar.documentoVinculadoNumero AS UNSIGNED) = so.pedido WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.tipo = 'TITULO' AND ar.vencimentoData <= '2026-05-20T23:59:59' AND so.estadoConfiguravel IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10
